reviews.author: Amaan Ehsan
reviews.text:
⭐ Very Disappointing Experience!

One of the staff members took my mum’s L’Oréal Paris hair colour cream from home but, apparently, didn’t read the product instructions properly and used the entire conditioner instead of the actual hair dye. This resulted in a waste of an expensive product, along with our valuable time. What made the experience even more disappointing was that the salon offered neither a discount nor complimentary service to compensate for their mistake. Customers should not have to bear the cost of staff negligence. Very unprofessional service and poor customer handling. I would expect better responsibility and customer care from a salon.
reviews.owner_reply:
Hi Aman,

I was present at the salon and personally explained the product to your mum. I clarified that usually, hair colour comes in a tube and conditioner in a bottle, but in this particular product, the packaging was the opposite, which caused the confusion. We apologize on this part.

I would also like to clarify that the product was not wasted. I explained to your mum that the conditioner could be mixed with the hair colour for a smoother result. She appeared happy with the final outcome, and I made sure to explain everything to her politely and clearly.

Additionally, I noticed that the colour product she brought had a very strong smell and appeared to contain harsh chemicals. Keeping her hair health in mind, I recommended that next time she consider our ammonia-free hair colour as a gentler alternative. This is the kind of personalised care we believe in — not just providing a service, but guiding our customers towards what we feel is best for their hair.

We take customer care seriously, and in this case, we made sure your mum was informed, advised, and comfortable with the result. We always strive to provide the best possible service and honest recommendations for our customers.

Had you wished to discuss a discount or any other concern, you were welcome to speak to me directly so we could address the matter in person, rather than having a misunderstanding shared publicly.

I’m happy to discuss this with you directly and clear up any concerns. You can call or WhatsApp me on 050 525 2506.

Thank you.

reviews.author: Asiya Mukadam
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I’ve been going to Manasi Ladies Salon for more than a decade and it has always been one of the best budget-friendly salons in the Meena Bazaar area. Their prices are very affordable compared to many other salons, yet the quality of service is consistently excellent.

The staff is extremely friendly, welcoming and professional. They make every customer feel comfortable and give proper attention to their needs. Whether it’s hair services, threading, facials or other beauty treatments, the experience is always satisfying.

What I truly appreciate is their consistency over the years — good service, hygienic environment and reasonable prices all in one place. It’s hard to find a salon that maintains both affordability and quality for such a long time.

Highly recommended for all ladies looking for a reliable, friendly and affordable salon in Meena Bazaar. Definitely a trusted place I keep coming back to again and again! 💖
Thank you Manasi Salon ✨🙌🫶🏻
